memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “No grain offering that you bring to the Lord shall be made with leaven, for you shall burn no leaven nor any honey in any offering to the Lord.” ( Leviticus 2:11 )

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The Lord commanded that the bread of offering be unleavened  pure, simple, and undefiled. Leaven in the Bible often represents sin, pride, hypocrisy, and corruption. So when God says, “Let your bread be unleavened,” He is calling for a life that is pure, holy, and separated from the world’s defilement.
Your life is the bread offered on God’s altar.
Your praise, your worship, your service  all must be without leaven. In today’s world, many worship with style but not sanctity; show but not surrender;
emotion but not obedience. The modern altar is filled with self-designed adoration that pleases people, not God.
But God desires your whole, not your half.
When worldly ways mix into your worship,
they may look beautiful, sound sweet, or feel emotional  but they spoil the sacred portion and turn the dough of life into leavened bread  unfit for holy fire.
Let your life, praise, and heart be unleavened before God  simple, sincere, and separated unto Him alone.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “God looks not for the art of worship, but for the heart of worship.” ( A.W. Tozer )

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, keep my heart and worship free from the leaven of the world. Cleanse me from pride and impurity. Let my life be a pure offering upon Your altar holy, undefiled, and pleasing in Your sight. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May your worship be pure like unleavened bread.
May the fragrance of your holiness rise continually before the Lord.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: “THE PURSUIT OF GOD”
recommended_book.author: A.W. Tozer
recommended_book.quote: "Of course the will of God is the same for all. He has no favorites within His household. All He has ever done for any of His children He will do for all of His children. The difference lies not with God but with us ".
